Ana: Repro for a weird importer/namespace issue with our JS SDK + bundlers hitting edge runtimes. Different from the usual default/.default confusion.
Jun: tl;dr?
Ana: Bundled app ends up with a namespace object lacking runtime functions — e.g. `import Redwood from 'redwood-inference'` becomes `{ __esModule: true }` after rollup + terser for edge, then runtime errors `Redwood.generate is not a function`. Happens on Vercel Edge and Cloudflare Workers.
Rhea: Any minimal steps?
Ana: Yep:
```
1) repo: https://example.com/rw-bundler-ns-repro
2) npm ci
3) npm run build:vite (vite->rollup, esbuild minify)
4) deploy to edge or run in local edge emulator
```
Ana: package.json in SDK uses conditional exports: {"import":"dist/index.mjs","require":"dist/index.cjs"} where index.mjs `export default class Redwood { ... }`.
Jun: Interesting — which minifier and terser/esbuild options? Mangle/properties sometimes drop names used by interop helpers.
Ana: In Vite's production build (esbuild) the bundle shows `var redwood_inference = /*#__PURE__*/Object.freeze({});` for that module in vendor chunk. Looks like tree-shaken but not fully removed.
Rhea: Could be sideEffects + named import confusion + terser removing unused symbols because it thinks exports are types-only. Any top-level `import type` in consumer?
Ana: No types-only imports. Consumer file is tiny runtime code.
Jun: Workaround that reproduced: change consumer to `import * as RW from 'redwood-inference'; const client = RW.default ? new RW.default() : new RW();` — gross but works.
Rhea: Fixes on SDK side: 1) add explicit named export `export function createClient(opts){ return new Redwood(opts) }` 2) ensure ESM entry uses named exports as well as default 3) add `exports.browser` conditional to package.json so bundlers pick proper entry.
Ana: Filed issue with repro and CI logs. build-bot: CI run failed on branch fix/export-named: https://ci.example.com/9012 — `TypeError: Redwood.generate is not a function`.
Jun: Also add a small bundle-smoke test in CI that runs the minified bundle in `node --input-type=module` to catch this before release.
Rhea: Agreed. I'll draft SDK PR to add named `createClient` and update README with bundler config snippets for Vite/Rollup/webpack (resolve.mainFields and plugin-node-resolve opts).
Ana: Thanks — tagging @pkg-maintainers. Will paste issue/PR links when available. :rocket
